capability: Candidate-level practical Oil compatibility; neither native path classification nor material segmentation.
added_information: Original native 7x7 RGB arrangements in the fixed CR1 +/-12 side footprint, with direct candidate correspondence/practical/opposition supervision; no coarse frozen prototype similarities.
geometry: Required floor/ceil variants, native RGB /255, no resize, no padding; every complete visible/glare-free 7x7 patch wholly in upper dy[-12,-2] or lower dy[2,12], dx[-12,12]. At least one complete patch per side; keep all others. No inferred horizontal contour or pure-side labels.
loss: Equal weight per candidate; mean cross-entropy over its required variants, then mean over 10 fit candidates. Patch count is not label count.
evaluation: Every Oil candidate with available input scored once at the final checkpoint. All required variants must agree; exact ties/disagreement UNKNOWN. 4 context controls and the separate Foam candidate remain excluded.
pass: All 10 fit controls correct; at least one of 4 accepted public lower candidates preserved; wrong current published public idx3 rejected. Report losses per candidate and all unknowns. LIMITED exposed transfer only.
ablation: Final inference only: replace every side patch by that side tensor RGB mean, preserving color contrast and shape. No retraining. If full and ablated controls both pass, native pattern necessity remains unestablished.
stop: If any required control lacks input, do not fit. One final-only 1000-step trial; no seed/crop/threshold/head/optimizer/split retry. Failure closes this hypothesis. Success does not authorize production or waive calibration/Windows.
exposure: Fit: one already exposed sample4 recording, 7 compatible (6 original correspondences + practical B) and 3 opposed; original reference is a normal historical control, not a new bank. Evaluation: one already exposed public recording, 4 practical alternatives plus one wrong published location. No untouched holdout.
